prior_attempt.distinction: New disjoint task families; existing native/TRPO/PPO experiments continue unchanged.

limits: All8 operational train/save/load gates must pass per host before formal training.
2M is this complete-series training budget; convergence/SOTA and10M extensions are separate unaccepted questions.
No outcome-dependent stopping, retries, checkpoint selection or replacement of existing runs.
Host assignment fixed per task: all methods/seeds of that task use the same host/runtime.
Native expected aggregate-cost benchmark; not a hard-zero or heterogeneous-constraint certificate.
Three epsilon values are candidate operating points; soft/hard endpoint correspondence is not presumed.
Vision/other observation tracks, multi-agent, Isaac and Safety-CHORES remain in parent inventory and require subsequent adapters.
CPO upstream unchanged except1CPU thread. Fixed-penalty arm uses zero multiplier learning rate; verify constant prices in logs.
All105 tasks,8 methods,3 seeds retained, including failed environment probes.
FormulaOne registry horizon is huge; unmodified Builder also truncates at task.num_steps. Every task must complete two bounded termination probes before training.
These are vector observations of all Safe Vision task families, not pixel-policy training or whole Safety-Gymnasium completion.
Priority hosts use measured remaining CPU capacity; aliyun CPU overflow does not require PPU/CUDA compatibility.
2M/312 and aggregate cost25 are frozen exploratory protocol choices, not an official SOTA protocol or zero-risk certificate.
